series.$note: series.observed holds several sources and must not be read as one curve. DS-35: All greenhouse gases including land-use change, GWP100 (OWID, from Climate Watch / PIK), from 1990. DS-02: Asset-level observed emissions, CO₂e GWP100 (Climate TRACE); land use accounted differently from OWID, 2015-2025. DS-40: Total GHG emissions including LULUCF/LUCF exactly as the Party submitted them to the UNFCCC, on that Party’s own reporting guidelines and GWP set (UNFCCC Data Interface, snapshot of 2024-07-05). Non-Annex I Parties report only the years their national communications cover, and the figure is negative where reported removals exceed reported emissions. Points from an NDC document are that document's own inventory basis. The same year can appear more than once with different values; R3 keeps them side by side and never averages them.

ndc_assessment.summary: Please note that the INDC was submitted only in French. WRI did its best to translate the INDC language. If any errors are identified, please contact us at ClimateWatch@WRI.org "L'Union des Comores s'engage à réduire ses émissions de gaz à effet de serre de 84% à l'horizon 2030 par rapport aux émissions du scénario de référence de la même année. Cette réduction inclut les absorptions du secteur Utilisation des Terres, Changement d'Affectation des terres et Foresterie (UTCAF) également." The Union of the Comoros aims to reduce its greenhouse gas emissions by 84% by 2030 relative to reference scenario emission levels in the same year. This reduction includes sinks from the Land Use, Land-Use Change, and Forestry (LULUCF) sector.
ndc_assessment.ghg_target: 84% reduction in GHG emissions by 2030 compared to the reference scenario, including sinks from the Land Use, Land-Use Change, and Forestry (LULUCF) sector.

emissions_profile.$note: Headline totals are OWID only. OWID's CO₂ sub-totals are fossil/industrial CO₂ by fuel, not a full sectoral GHG breakdown, and do not sum to total_mtco2e. DS-05's rows are non-CO₂ gases only and are not comparable with the others; that is also why DS-05 is absent from series.observed, where a shorter curve would read as a disagreement rather than a difference of scope. by_source carries each source whole.

verdict.text: Comoros pledges a 84% reduction by 2030 against 2030 business-as-usual. A later submission, NDC 3.0, was filed on 2026-03-30; it has not been read, so no figure here comes from it. 48 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (2). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-35 1 MtCO₂e, DS-02 0.9 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: the pledge is 84% below a business-as-usual projection for 2030. That projection is not in any source loaded here, so the percentage cannot be turned into a tonnage and the trend cannot be judged against it. ND-GAIN scores it 38.5 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: 84% reduction in GHG emissions by 2030 compared to the reference scenario, including sinks from the Land Use, Land-Use Change, and Forestry (LULUCF) sector. It was classed conditional. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +0.85°C under SSP1-2.6 to +3.11°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
